findings.name: Firmware not verified at boot
findings.summary: The computer does not check its own firmware when it starts, so changed firmware would still run. Keep the machine physically safe.

findings.name: Intel AMT present and not set up
findings.summary: The machine has Intel's remote management (AMT), switched on but not set up. Someone with physical access could set it up for remote control; disable AMT in the firmware settings if you do not use it.

findings.name: Intel ME firmware with known vulnerabilities
findings.summary: The Intel Management Engine firmware is a version with known security flaws, and HP no longer ships updates for it. Install software only from sources you trust.

findings.name: Thunderbolt without DMA protection
findings.summary: A Thunderbolt device you approve can read and write all of the computer's memory. Only approve Thunderbolt devices you trust. USB-C hubs and screens are not affected.
